Hero.title: Your home, always online

Pricing.title: Transparent pricing
Pricing.subtitle: No hidden fees. Cancel any time.

q1.a: Our crew arrives within 24 hours. Installation takes 2-4 hours depending on device count.

q2.q: Can I use my own cameras?
q2.a: Yes — any ONVIF or RTSP camera works. We verify compatibility for free.

q3.a: In a Tier III data centre in Yekaterinburg. All data is encrypted, only you have access.

q4.q: What if the internet goes down?
q4.a: The local hub keeps running: records to SD, runs scenarios, sends SMS over GSM.

q5.q: Will it work in a new-build flat?
q5.a: Yes. If there's no smart-device wiring, our engineers design a wireless setup.

q6.a: First 14 days are free — no card required. Cancel any time, no questions asked.
